tooltips.semi_major_axis: The semi-major axis defines the size of the orbit. For a circular orbit, it equals the orbital radius.
tooltips.eccentricity: Eccentricity describes the shape: 0 = circle, 0–1 = ellipse, 1 = parabola, >1 = hyperbola.
tooltips.inclination: The angle between the orbital plane and Earth's equatorial plane. 0° = equatorial, 90° = polar.
tooltips.raan: Right Ascension of the Ascending Node — the 'longitude' of the orbital plane in inertial space.
tooltips.arg_perigee: Angle from the ascending node to the perigee point, measured in the orbital plane.
tooltips.mean_anomaly: A fictitious angle that grows linearly with time, used to locate the satellite in its orbit.
tooltips.period: Time to complete one full orbit.
tooltips.raan_drift: Due to Earth's J₂ oblateness, the orbital plane precesses westward for prograde orbits.
tooltips.bstar: Ballistic coefficient used in SGP4/SDP4 drag modelling. Units: 1/R⊕.

tooltips.hohmann: Most fuel-efficient two-burn transfer between two coplanar circular orbits.
tooltips.bielliptic: Three-burn transfer, more efficient than Hohmann when r₂/r₁ > 11.94.
tooltips.plane_change: Rotates the orbital plane. Very expensive in Δv — best done at apogee of a highly eccentric orbit.
